prerequisites: Having passed at least 120 ECTS of the study plan.
Not having exceeded the total course load of the study plan or already holding the degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Contribute to the comprehensive training of students, complementing their theoretical and practical teachings.
Facilitate knowledge of the appropriate work methodology for the professional reality in which students will operate as graduates, contrasting and applying acquired knowledge.
Prepare students for working in teams.
Promote the development of students' decision-making capacity and critical thinking.

syllabus_topics: Particular conditions of each internship placement
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.5 * Internship Report Grade + 0.5 * Monitoring Grade. A minimum of 4 points is required in both the Internship Report Grade and the Monitoring Grade to pass the subject. The final grade must be 5 or higher to pass. If the minimums for the Internship Report Grade and/or Monitoring Grade are not met, the maximum final grade will be 4 points. Extraordinary calls follow the same procedure as the ordinary one.
